name: Plotly charts views
description: Display Views results as Plotly.js charts.
project_description:
This module uses plotly.js cdn to draw charts with module views.

The special point is that plotly can zoom/pan the chart.

 Features 
 Views plotly charts style supports plotly all type:

 Basic plots 

 
 Scatter Plots 
 Line Charts 
 Bar Charts 
 Pie Charts 
 Bubble Charts 
 Dot Plots 
 Filled Area Plots 
 Horizontal Bar Charts 
 Sunburst Charts 
 Sankey Diagrams 
 Treemaps 
 Tables 
 
 Statistical Charts 

 
 Box Plots 
 Histograms 
 2D Histograms 
 2D Histogram Contour 
 Density Plots 
 Violin Plot 
 Parallel Categories Diagram 
 Splom 
 
 Scientific Charts 

 
 Contour Plots 
 Heatmaps 
 Ternary Plots 
 Parallel Coordinates Plot 
 Wind Rose Charts 
 Ternary Contour Plots 
 Radar Charts 
 
 Financial Charts 

 
 Waterfall Charts 
 Indicators 
 Candlestick Charts 
 Funnel Charts 
 Time Series 
 Open High Low Close Charts 
 
 3D Charts 

 
 3D Scatter Plots 
 Ribbon Plots 
 3D Surface Plots 
 3D Mesh Plots 
 3D Line Plots 
 
 Create a views and choose the Plotly style. Then choose show the fields. Go to Plotly's configuration to associate fields with columns. After choosing the type of plot, you can save and re-open configuration it will optimal display with the corresponding type (Unfortunately, this is not practical). Normally, you can choose the x-axis as the axis to display the label, with the other fields on the y-axis. You can hide the other fields if you don't want them to appear on the chart. The view name and description will become the title and legend displayed on the chart. After choosing the view, click the sample link to display the data needed for the chart to associate the fields along the corresponding axis.

You can combine multiple chart types: select the "date" field on the x-axis, the bar style for the "income" field, and the line style for the "expenses" field.
